title: CurrentCourse
description: The compressed user-facing Argus output. It shows the user's current decision course, evidence, open risk, set-aside option, next step action, and optional decision-prediction to check.

status.description: The user's practical course right now.

summary.description: One sentence explaining the current course.

why_this_course.description: Concrete reasons tied to the user's actual file, repo, PR, document, or session evidence.

source.description: File path, PR ref, document ref, worker id, or session artifact reference.

open_risk.description: The biggest remaining uncertainty, contradiction, unsupported claim, or human-only check.

set_aside_options.description: Evidence-backed alternate courses that were genuinely considered but should not be the current course. EMPTY on a flat decision (no real fork) — never fabricate an alternative to fill the slot; a manufactured set-aside option is over-fire (mirror clause, v2.6.0). Each pole must be rendered at parity with the chosen course (no charity asymmetry, no caveat stacking, no 'melting' one side's cost) — a tilting set-aside option is a disguised verdict.

next_step.description: The next concrete action, ideally under 30 minutes unless the decision truly requires more.

prediction_to_check.description: A falsifiable prediction candidate to seal later as a Decision Contract.

blocked.description: True when the current course should not be executed before a repair or human check.

detail_path.description: Path to the full .argus session version for users who want depth.
